items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: So they told the Cardinal not to do it.

ctx.x: because there had never been a jazz mass in Rome. What they did, what really stopped it, the Italians like to be told what they're going to do but everybody was afraid to tell them because it would have taken them another year to say yes. So they said, well, let's do it fast. It would have gone through but the girl at the Vatican radio caught us or played it smart. She came in one afternoon while we were rehearsing and said, "Guess what, I just broadcast the mass right on the lap of the Pope." The Pope listened…
As things are now, Mary, are you active in the church?
